summary: Version the Fractal Web immutable build helpers with same-filesystem snapshots and counted cross-device dependency fallback.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of application data.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes. Deployment build receipts retain dependencyFiles linked/copied counts.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only build scripts. Deployment owners provide explicit build and snapshot roots; snapshots must share the source clone filesystem. The sibling dependency helper is resolved beside the build script.

downtime.detail: No running service is activated by this PR.

manual.detail: No released-product manual step. Deployment owners can adopt the versioned helpers by supplying their roots and private build entry point.

recovery.detail: Application data is unchanged. The integrator owns current-plus-one rollback retention after confirmed edge activation; the build helper does not prune before publication.
